# bugs #3393: Designated initializer for a member of a nested anonymous union is missing from data images

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3393/
- Category: [Analyzed, not fixed](../../unresolved.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Keep open for the nested-union case of the third comment, or move that case to a new ticket and close this one.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The ticket contains three cases. Two are fixed in trunk, and the third is still wrong on r17176.
A test file with all three was compiled for mcs51 and run in ucsim with the small, medium, large,
and huge models, and with `--stack-auto` for small and large.

- The reported case is the struct of `qct/0051-inits`, which has an anonymous union before a nested
  struct. It gets the right values in every model, and so does a local `struct S v = {1, 2, 3};` of
  the form in the first comment.
- The case of the second comment is a union of several structs with bit-fields. It gets the right
  values in every model.
- The case of the third comment is `struct W` of `support/regression/tests/bug-3393-designated.c`
  with the initializer `{.a = 1, .t = 9, .z = 4}`. Where the compiler emits the object as a data
  image, the image is `01 00 00 00 04`. The correct image is `01 00 09 00 04`.

For mcs51 the third case is wrong for `const` objects and `__xdata` objects in every model, and for
file-scope objects without a storage class in the large and huge models. It is right for objects
that code initializes, which are file-scope objects in the small and medium models and automatic
and static local objects in every model. Other ports were not tested.

## Known

[r16733](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/16733/) fixed the reported case. `createIvalStruct` in
`src/SDCCast.c` skips each member that is not a bit-field and whose offset is below the end of the
member that it initialized before. That is true for the other alternatives of an anonymous union
after `promoteAnonStructs` has moved them into the enclosing struct. The revision also enables
`qct_0051-inits` for all targets.

[r16762](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/16762/) applied patch #508, which fixed the bit-field
case and added `bug-3393-designated.c`.

The third case fails in `printIvalStruct` in `src/SDCCglue.c`. `promoteAnonStructs` sets
`anonunionalias` for the members of every alternative except the first one, so the flat member list
of `struct W` is `a`, `p`, `x`, `y`, `r`, `s`, `t`, `u`, `z` with the flag set for `x`, `y`, `s`,
`t`, and `u`. For each member `printIvalStruct` calls `designatedAlternative`, which searches the
next run of `anonunionalias` members for a member that has an initializer. The function accepts
that member only when the lowest offset in the run equals the offset of the member it was called
for. Member `r` of the first alternative separates the run `x`, `y` from the run `s`, `t`, `u`. The
run that contains `t` is therefore found from `r`, which has offset 3 while the run begins at
offset 1, and `designatedAlternative` returns `NULL`. The loop in `printIvalStruct` that skips
`anonunionalias` members then advances past the initializer of `t` without emitting it.

The checks for this case in `bug-3393-designated.c` are inside `#if 0`. The comment there counts
mcs51 among the ports that are correct, which holds only for objects that code initializes.

## Open

A fix has to make `printIvalStruct` treat the members of the outer union as one union although a
member of its first alternative separates them in the flat list. According to the comment in
`bug-3393-designated.c`, the flat list does not record where a union ends. No patch is offered.
